attributes.residual: Unchanged: real 95, insns 227/228, opcode multiset DIFFERS ours-only -1 mr, one cluster @0x17c. NAMED MECHANISM: target materializes the file-local array base directly into the walking pointer's home register - `addi r4,r3,0 @sMilestones(ADDR16_LO)` with the HA in r3 and the result in r4 - while our build emits `addi r3,r3,0 @sMilestones(ADDR16_LO)` into the HA's own register and then `mr r4,r3`. CROSS-FUNCTION FINDING, the reason this record matters beyond its own function: this is the SAME mechanism already capped on fn_80046680 by attempt.parked.fn-80046680.20260830.v1, whose cap text names it as 'stock LO->r0 plus mr r26 versus target direct LO->r26, coupled to lis/fmr scheduling'. Two independent functions in this TU (move_logic22 with sMilestones, fn_80046680 with gPlayers) now exhibit one identical LO-into-scratch-plus-mr mechanism, so it should be treated as a TU-level (probably project-level) codegen class rather than re-derived per function. fn_80046680's cap already burned the direct/enclosing-base, register/typed-induction, balanced-stack-layout, scoped-lifetime and grouped-loop-init forms against it; those are therefore ALREADY-DEAD axes for move_logic22 too and should not be re-spent. Recommend the next agent treat this as one shared target: either find a single source form that flips LO's destination register, or characterize it as a machine-provable REGISTER_ONLY mechanism and screen it for the WebFrank path with the our-colouring discriminant (claim.law.webfrank-permutation-is-audited-in-our-colouring.20260831.v1) - it is a strong candidate because the instruction streams are otherwise identical and the delta is one surplus copy, not a schedule change.
